# Motion Graphics Skill Pack

> Give your AI agent a motion director

Official repository: https://github.com/imMamdouhaboammar/motion-graphics-skills

Motion Graphics Skill Pack is a set of 15 skills for Claude Code and Codex. It covers motion direction, brand intake, motion briefs, multi-reference creative recombination, launch films, explainers, animated charts, 3D title sequences, motion effects, social video, Arabic and RTL motion, and render review.

The master motion-director skill owns concept, narrative, art direction, typography, composition, choreography, Arabic direction and creative QA.

For new code-driven motion projects, HyperFrames is the preferred production infrastructure for deterministic timelines, reusable registry blocks, diagnostics, preview, audio relationships, variants and final rendering.

Key topics:
- motion graphics
- motion design
- Claude Code
- Codex
- agent skills
- HyperFrames
- programmatic video
- kinetic typography
- 2D, 2.5D and 3D motion
- Arabic and RTL motion
- creative coding
- GSAP
- Three.js

Install:
npx skills add imMamdouhaboammar/motion-graphics-skills
